description: Promotion codes on the brand's Stripe account — the codes customers TYPE at checkout — with the coupon each applies, active or not, times redeemed / max, expiry, first-purchase-only and minimum-order rules. Filter by active, code or couponId. Read-only, free. Needs Stripe connected (Settings > Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

active.description: true = active codes only; false = inactive codes only

after.description: pagination cursor: the last promotion code id from the previous page

code.description: customer-typable promotion code text to find

couponId.description: only codes that apply this coupon, from list_stripe_coupons

name: list_stripe_promotion_codes
title: list stripe promotion codes
